list.name: client_platform
list.label: 客户端平台
list.query: WebGL : webgl,Windows Player : windows,Unity Editor : editor,其他客户端 : other,未知/历史未上报 : unknown,无客户端归属 : unattributed

list.name: distribution_channel
list.label: 发行渠道
list.query: 内部版 : internal,Steam : steam,TapTap : taptap,网页版 : web,未知／历史未上报 : unknown

list.name: release_version
list.label: 发布版本
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') AS __text,COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') AS __value FROM analytics_sessions ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: playtest_id
list.label: Playtest 批次
list.query: 全部 : all,中秋playtest : 中秋playtest,历史／未标记 : legacy

list.name: test_data
list.label: 测试数据
list.query: 按平台自动 : auto,排除 : exclude,包含 : include,仅测试 : only

options.content: **默认包含 WebGL、Windows Player 和未知/历史未上报；可单独筛选 Unity Editor。** 旧客户端没有上报平台的记录在「未知/历史未上报」中，不能根据版本名推断。平台多选按用户去重。旧游戏事件缺少真实时间，见经营总览及猫与 AI 页的「历史累计」；这些面板不受右上角时间范围影响。期间事件面板为空不代表历史没有行为。所有日期按北京时间。测试数据「按平台自动」会在 Editor 中保留测试记录。

panels.title: 猫与 AI 事件覆盖
panels.description: 遵守时间、平台和版本筛选。缺失值不补零；历史事件没有真实时间时不纳入期间统计。

targets.queryText: WITH e AS (SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor'))) AND ('${playtest_id}'='all' OR ('${playtest_id}'='legacy' AND (user_id,session_id) NOT IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_playtests)) OR (user_id,session_id) IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_playtests WHERE playtest_id='${playtest_id}')) AND ('__all__' IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring}) OR (user_id,session_id) IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_channels WHERE distribution_channel IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring})) OR ('unknown' IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring}) AND (user_id,session_id) NOT IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_channels))) AND julianday(occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch') ) SELECT event_type,COUNT(*) 次数,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) 用户数 FROM e WHERE event_type LIKE 'cat_%' OR event_type LIKE 'ai_%' OR event_type='player_cat_interaction' GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY 次数 DESC
